overview.description: The GraniteShares Autocallable NVDA ETF (ANV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is actively managed, investing in a laddered portfolio of single-stock autocallable options referencing the price of NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ: NVDA). It aims to generate monthly income with limited downside cushion. ANV was launched on Feb 3, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.
